razonamiento: The visual diagram and narration show a serverless web and API architecture for call center/enterprise agents. The user icon corresponds to agents (UserCompanyAgent) accessing a Single Page Application (SPA) hosted on S3 and distributed via CloudFront. Dynamic API calls pass through CloudFront to API Gateway, which invokes an Authorizer Lambda to validate access and forwards authorized requests to a Python backend Lambda. This Lambda interfaces with DynamoDB for caching user information and connects to a legacy Tomcat application running on EC2.
nombre: Serverless SPA and API Modernization with CloudFront, Lambda, and DynamoDB
